newsitem.title: USA: AlphaNet seeks to issue 2.0 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: AlphaNet seeks to issue 2.0 mln shrs.

text.p: AlphaNet Solutions Inc said Friday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue 2.0 million shares of its common stock.
The company, which provides information technology products, said it would issue 1.15 million and certain shareholders would offer the other 850,000.
The offering is being made through an underwriting group managed by Montgomery Securities, Cruttenden Roth Inc and Parker/Hunter Inc, it added.
